non-blocking: test_the_bound_is_the_document_time_not_the_run_id asserts only relations among constants the test itself computes (id_stamp parsed from LONG_QUEUED[0], BOUND from NOW and WINDOW-derived BOUND at line 39), so it exercises no production path and cannot fail on a regression of the bound; it guards fixture separation, and counting it as coverage overstates durability.

non-blocking: no assertion pins DOCUMENT_AGE_MARGIN. The fixture's stamps sit 50 h, 27 h and 200 days from the bound, so setting the production margin to zero (reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:70) passes all five tests, leaving the clock-skew cushion the margin exists for unguarded.
